environment.description: Django REST service deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1 behind an internal-scheme ALB (not internet-facing). The ALB's security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) has ingress rules permitting TCP/443 only from sg-0b7d3a9e5f (the corporate VPN gateway ENI security group) and from CIDR 10.128.0.0/16 (shared services VPC peering range). A VPC endpoint policy on the execute-api interface endpoint restricts source IPs to 10.128.0.0/16 and 172.20.0.0/14. Additionally, the ECS service's task networking uses awsvpc mode in private subnets (10.0.64.0/19, 10.0.96.0/19) with no NAT gateway egress path for inbound connections. Route table rt-0c2e4f8a has no 0.0.0.0/0 route; only VPC-local and peered CIDR routes exist. The NLB in front of the internal ALB has a Proxy Protocol v2 header requirement, and the ALB listener rule validates X-Forwarded-For against a prefix list (pl-04e2b8c1a7) containing only 172.20.0.0/14 and 10.200.0.0/16 corporate egress ranges before forwarding to the target group.

config.route_table: VPC-local and peered CIDRs only, no 0.0.0.0/0
